connector.name: Ainpc Cli
connector.registryDescription: AI NPCs with persistent memory for game studios. NPC CRUD, dialogue, voice. Stdio or remote SSE.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.ainpcengine.com over server sent events, also runs locally from the npm package ainpc-cli. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the jyswee account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token using your AINPCEngine API key: 'Bearer npk_...'. Optional: without one the server starts in onboarding mode and can self-signup via the ainpc_signup tool.

env.name: AINPC_API_KEY
env.description: AINPCEngine API key (npk_...). Get one with `ainpc signup` — 7-day free trial.

env.name: AINPC_GAME_ID
env.description: Game slug to scope NPC tools to.
